project.title: Codrops GSAP Creative Hub Interaction Patterns
project.format: scroll, carousel, shader, mask, and transition pattern library

why: A compact reference set for modern frontend motion patterns: scroll-synced video/image cues, 3D text, draggable carousels, mask reveals, WebGL shaders, and page transitions are grouped with live demos and implementation context.

compositions.title: Scroll-synced visual chapters
compositions.study: The collection surfaces patterns where scroll progress maps to image, video, depth, mask, and typography changes.
compositions.reuse: Use when a page needs motion to reveal structure or meaning instead of only adding polish.

compositions.title: Draggable and infinite motion modules
compositions.study: Carousel and grid demos show how repeated content can feel spatial and tactile without becoming hard to navigate.
compositions.reuse: Use for galleries, product collections, and media browsers with clear keyboard and reduced-motion alternatives.

assets.notes: The useful asset is not copied code but named timing, trigger, scrub, and reveal rules.
assets.reuse: Record duration, trigger point, easing intent, and fallback state for each pattern.

assets.notes: Scroll, drag, hover, and pointer behavior should be mapped before animation polish.
assets.reuse: Define which inputs are primary on desktop and what replaces them on touch devices.

motion.title: Timed scroll cue sequence
motion.notes: Video, image, mask, and type motion can be synchronized to reading progress.
motion.fallback: Provide static section order and avoid hiding essential content behind animation.

motion.title: Depth-based repeated content
motion.notes: 3D and parallax effects can imply depth while preserving active item clarity.
motion.fallback: Flatten to a standard carousel or stacked grid.

interactions.title: Pointer-driven spatial browsing
interactions.study: Drag interactions can turn browsing into tactile exploration when position and focus remain obvious.
interactions.reuse: Keep drag affordances visible and support non-pointer navigation.

implementation.notes: Useful as a pattern index before building GSAP, WebGL, scroll, or carousel-heavy experiences.
